methods.label: Subtract two tens
methods.explanation: \(46\) has 4 tens and 6 ones. Subtracting \(20\) removes 2 tens, leaving 2 tens and 6 ones. \(46-20=26\). So 26 books remain.
methods.levelReason: Uses Grade 1 subtraction of whole tens while keeping the ones unchanged.

candidate.annotationRationale: The task asks for an exact difference. Because the subtraction expression is supplied, constructing a subtraction model is not an additional assessed requirement. The revised method explicitly subtracts whole tens, fitting cnm_p030, with cnm_p017 supporting the tens-and-ones interpretation. A route-neutral target is proposed below. needsNewNodes.description: Calculate a nonnegative exact difference by subtracting a one-digit whole number or a multiple of ten from a two-digit whole number, with or without regrouping, without prescribing mental calculation or a written layout.
